aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari;
Bābā, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari.
and wear a form beyond compare.
aarti.pad2: You sit on a jewel-studded throne;
a whisk is waved above your head.
and earrings hang in your ears.
aarti.pad1: A garland of flowers is round your neck,
and you wear a crown on your head;
incense is cast on the fire,
aarti.pad3: Golden plates are filled with modakas, kheer and cūrmā;
your servants offer them to you
aarti.pad4: Cymbals, the struck bowl and gongs,
aarti.pad5: and is freed from every sorrow;
your servants, with their own lips,
aarti.pad6: Whoever sings the āratī of Śrī Śyāma Bihārījī —
gains the fruit the heart desires.
aarti.pad7: Victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari;
Bābājī, victory to you, Śrī Śyāma Hari.
You have fulfilled the wishes of your devotees.
